description: This file declares factory classes and functions for creating Discrete Fourier Transform (DFT) processors, including support for different libraries (FFTW, AOCL-FFTZ) and data types (complex 16-bit). It provides interfaces for generating DFT processor instances and factory creation functions with various optimization settings.

classes.name: dft_processor_factory
classes.description: Abstract factory class for creating DFT processors.

classes.name: dft_processor_ci16_factory
classes.description: Factory class for creating DFT processors for 16-bit complex integer data.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Pure virtual method to create a DFT processor based on provided configuration.

methods.name: create_dft_processor_factory_generic
methods.description: Creates a DFT processor factory based on a generic Radix-2 DFT implementation.

methods.name: create_dft_processor_factory_fftw
methods.description: Creates a DFT processor factory based on FFTW library with specified optimization and timeout.

methods.name: create_dft_processor_factory_fftz
methods.description: Creates a DFT processor factory based on AOCL-FFTZ library.

methods.name: create_dft_processor_factory_fftw_slow
methods.description: Creates a sub-optimal FFTW-based DFT processor factory with estimate mode.

methods.name: create_dft_processor_factory_fftw_fast
methods.description: Creates an optimized FFTW-based DFT processor factory with measure mode, conditional on sanitization.

methods.name: create_dft_processor_ci16_factory_avx2
methods.description: Creates a factory for DFT processors optimized with AVX2 for 16-bit complex integer data.
